tokens.name: rm-ink
tokens.usage: Navy ink. The brand's text colour and the inverse surface (utility bar, navy blocks, footer). Base palette: reach it through the semantic tokens.

tokens.name: rm-logo-navy
tokens.usage: The logo ink, from the logo files. For the logo and nothing else; text stays rm-ink.

tokens.name: rm-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink. Base palette behind text-secondary.

tokens.name: rm-ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted ink. Base palette behind text-muted (5.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: rm-sky
tokens.usage: Sky blue: the fill and mark colour for Family Medicine, the focus ring and highlights. For text use rm-sky-text (text-link).

tokens.name: rm-sky-soft
tokens.usage: Pale sky. Family Medicine tint and info notices.

tokens.name: rm-sun
tokens.usage: Sunshine. Accent buttons on navy, closing bands, the dark-theme focus ring. Always with sun-ink text.

tokens.name: rm-sun-soft
tokens.usage: Soft sunshine. The accent surface behind closing CTA bands.

tokens.name: rm-sun-tint
tokens.usage: Sunshine tint. Rehab & Recovery tint and warning notices.

tokens.name: rm-sun-ink
tokens.usage: Dark text on sunshine (11.6:1 on rm-sun).

tokens.name: rm-terracotta
tokens.usage: Terracotta. Pain Centre colour for shapes and illustrations, not text.

tokens.name: rm-terracotta-deep
tokens.usage: Deep terracotta. A fill and mark colour; for small text use rm-terracotta-text.

tokens.name: rm-terracotta-tint
tokens.usage: Terracotta tint. Pain Centre tint and error notices.

tokens.name: rm-sage
tokens.usage: Sage. The open-now dot and Infusion Therapy shapes.

tokens.name: rm-sage-deep
tokens.usage: Deep sage. A fill and mark colour; for small text use rm-sage-text.

tokens.name: rm-sage-tint
tokens.usage: Sage tint. Infusion Therapy tint and success notices.

tokens.name: rm-sage-ink
tokens.usage: Dark sage text on sage tints.

tokens.name: rm-lilac-deep
tokens.usage: Deep lilac. A fill and mark colour; for small text use rm-lilac-text.

tokens.name: rm-amber-deep
tokens.usage: Deep amber. A fill and mark colour; for small text use rm-amber-text.

tokens.name: rm-sky-text
tokens.usage: Text version of the sky accent, mixed toward ink as the site does (globals.css), for small text: 5.4:1 on paper and 4.9:1 on its tint. The brand sky stays the fill.

tokens.name: rm-sage-text
tokens.usage: Text version of the sage accent, mixed toward ink as the site does (globals.css), for small text: 5.4:1 on paper and 4.8:1 on its tint. The brand sage stays the fill.

tokens.name: rm-lilac-text
tokens.usage: Text version of the lilac accent, mixed toward ink as the site does (globals.css), for small text: 7.0:1 on paper and 6.1:1 on its tint. The brand lilac stays the fill.

tokens.name: rm-amber-text
tokens.usage: Text version of the amber accent, mixed toward ink as the site does (globals.css), for small text: 5.3:1 on paper and 4.8:1 on its tint. The brand amber stays the fill.

tokens.name: rm-terracotta-text
tokens.usage: Text version of the terracotta accent, mixed toward ink as the site does (globals.css), for small text: 6.8:1 on paper and 5.8:1 on its tint. The brand terracotta stays the fill.

tokens.name: rm-paper
tokens.usage: White paper. Base palette behind bg-page and surface-raised.

tokens.name: rm-paper-2
tokens.usage: Cool off-white. Base palette behind surface-card.

tokens.name: rm-line
tokens.usage: Hairline grey. Base palette behind border-default and field-border.

tokens.name: rm-canvas
tokens.usage: Warm grey canvas shown around the page frame.

tokens.name: div-family
tokens.usage: Family Medicine tint: hero cards and division cards.

tokens.name: div-family-accent
tokens.usage: Family Medicine accent for icons, rules and large display marks on its tint. Small eyebrows and labels use rm-sky-text.

tokens.name: div-pain-accent
tokens.usage: Pain Centre accent for icons, rules and large display marks on its tint. Small eyebrows and labels use rm-terracotta-text.

tokens.name: div-infusion-accent
tokens.usage: Infusion Therapy accent for icons, rules and large display marks on its tint. Small eyebrows and labels use rm-sage-text.

tokens.name: div-aesthetics-accent
tokens.usage: Medical Aesthetics accent for icons, rules and large display marks on its tint. Small eyebrows and labels use rm-lilac-text.

tokens.name: div-rehab-accent
tokens.usage: Rehab & Recovery accent for icons, rules and large display marks on its tint. Small eyebrows and labels use rm-amber-text.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Behind the page frame and inside modal demos.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Default card fill (cards with a 1px border-default edge).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: result cards, modals, checkbox boxes.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Navy blocks: utility bar, path steps, footer. Text on it is text-on-inverse.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Sunshine closing bands. Text on it is text-on-accent.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Selected chips and option rows (2px), outline buttons.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body on bg-page, surface-card and surface-raised (16:1 on paper).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Lead and card body on bg-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, meta and helper text on bg-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Text links ending in ›, on bg-page, surface-card and tints (4.5:1 or more in every theme).

tokens.name: action-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Primary pill button fill: the main action in a block.

tokens.name: action-secondary-bg
tokens.usage: Secondary pill: booking steps and Book on service cards. White labels on it pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-open
tokens.usage: The 7px open-now dot in the utility bar.

tokens.name: status-success-fg
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on status-success-bg. Pair with a check glyph, never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-error-fg
tokens.usage: Error text and invalid field labels.

styles.name: display-page
styles.usage: Page H1 and landing hero. 56px at md, 40px on phones.

styles.name: display-photo
styles.usage: Headline over a photo hero. 44px at md, 34px on phones.

styles.name: display-section
styles.sample: Bring a book. We handle the rest.
styles.usage: Section H2 and the sticky FAQ heading. 40px at md, 32px on phones.

styles.name: display-sub
styles.sample: Find out in one blood test.
styles.usage: Subsection H2 and CTA band title. 28px at md, 26px on phones.

styles.name: title-row
styles.usage: List row and small card title. 20px on phones.

styles.name: display-em
styles.usage: The one italic phrase inside a display heading (Fraunces italic 400), at the heading's size.

styles.name: numeral-lg
styles.usage: Big numeral in benefit and coverage cards.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Physician-led care for your whole family, in Thornhill.
styles.usage: Hero lead under a page H1 (17px on phones), text-secondary.

styles.name: text-lg
styles.sample: A nurse stays with you the whole time.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bring your health card and a list of your medicines.

styles.name: card-body
styles.sample: About three hours in a lounge chair.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels (14px small, 16px large). Sentence case, verb plus object.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow above headings and breadcrumbs. Sentence case, never tracked capitals.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tags, field labels and chips (raised from 12px in the November 2026 design review).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The smallest tags and the mobile status bar (raised from 11px). Nothing smaller.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: Margin between full-bleed rounded blocks and the viewport edge.

tokens.name: radius-block
tokens.usage: Full-width rounded blocks, heroes, photos and the footer.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: List rows, option rows, search field.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating result cards and the modal. The only everyday shadow.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Card and divider edges (2px in the contrast theme).

tokens.name: border-width-selected
tokens.usage: Selected chips and option rows, in border-strong.
